hypothesis.primary: A PPO policy over continuous D-1 daily-DB features with the identical 10-slot / 60,000,000 KRW accounting achieves validation economic NAV above no-trade and at least equal to the best frozen RULE/random baseline at 0.23% cost, in a majority of seeds.
hypothesis.null: The PPO policy does not satisfy the criterion in a majority of seeds net of 0.23% cost on validation.
negative_controls: shuffled-label PPO control must NOT exceed max(no_trade, exposure-matched random mean + 2*std) at primary cost
zero-cost scenario is display-only and never used for the verdict

gym_env.episode: one trading session; candidate rows visited in symbol order
gym_env.action: Discrete(2): skip / enter (enter coerced to skip when 10 slots used or symbol already held)

algorithm.checkpoint_selection: best validation NAV among the eval checkpoints; final metrics from that checkpoint only
algorithm.policy_score: P(action=enter); session portfolio = top-10 distinct symbols among rows with P>0.5, ranked by P

baselines: identical to KRONOS-V7-PREREG-M1-2026-07-20 (no_trade, rule ret5/low_vol/inst, random_topk, exposure-matched random reps=20)

verdict_rules.negative_control_fail: any shuffled seed final val NAV > max(60000000, exposure_matched mean + 2*std) => NO_GO
verdict_rules.go_candidate: >=2 of 3 seeds with val NAV > 60000000 AND >= best of (rule/random baselines) => GO_CANDIDATE_VALIDATION_ONLY
verdict_rules.test_oos: untouched test split read once only on GO_CANDIDATE_VALIDATION_ONLY; otherwise NOT_RUN
verdict_rules.post_hoc_retune: forbidden; changes require a new preregistration version
